evidence.quote: Language and form of training English Full time
The tuition fee for NON EU Students is 4000 EUR/Academic year (2 semesters)
Admission period is between 15th of August and 15th of October.
Entry requirements Finished secondary school studies.

Language requirements: B2 level English language certificate (TOEFL/IELTS/ESOL/BEC/ECL/PTE/FCE/CAE/TELC/TOEIC/Euroexam), or Attestation of Language Proficiency in the case of former studies in English.

notes: The programme page is the only page describing this BSc; the admission page lists only Master's programmes for Spring 2027, so the 15 August–15 October admission period comes from a general faculty page and its applicant group (international vs local) is not stated, and the year is not given, hence recurringDeadline. The programme page also states 'Admission is closed', which is a status, not a dated deadline. Tuition: only the non-EU figure of 4000 EUR/Academic year is used; the EU figure of 3750 EUR is not relevant to this applicant. No application channel (online application form / Stipendium Hungaricum) is stated on the supplied pages, so applicationChannel is omitted.
